name: Les Mills
tagline: NZ's biggest gym chain — group fitness, premium facilities
cancellation: 30 days written notice after minimum term
watch_out: Minimum term required, pricing not published online — you must visit
discount_note: Under 23s get 20% off. Student discounts available.
verdict: Best for group fitness and premium facilities. Worth it if you use the classes.
pros: Best group fitness classes in NZ
Pools and saunas at most locations

google_reviews.name: Rachel T.
google_reviews.text: The group fitness classes are genuinely the best in NZ. Les Mills BodyPump changed my fitness level. The Auckland CBD club is well-maintained and the pool is always clean.

google_reviews.name: James K.
google_reviews.text: Great facilities, especially the pool and sauna. The 3-month minimum term is a barrier but once you're in it's absolutely worth every dollar.

google_reviews.name: Priya S.
google_reviews.text: Perfect for a lunchtime workout from the office. There's always a class on and the crèche means I can bring my toddler on weekends without stress.

google_reviews.name: Mike O.
google_reviews.text: Would be 5 stars but the pricing process is frustrating — you can't check rates online, you have to go in person. Once I signed up though the experience has been excellent.

google_reviews.name: Tara H.
google_reviews.text: Got the student discount and it's incredible value. The instructors know what they're doing and the class variety keeps it interesting every single week.

name: City Fitness
tagline: NZ's most affordable 24/7 gym — three membership tiers

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.includes: Gym floor access at your home club

tiers.name: Black Card
tiers.includes: All clubs + tanning + massage chairs + guest passes

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.includes: All clubs + all perks + group fitness classes

best_for: Budget-conscious members, early birds and night owls, multi-club users
watch_out: No pool or sauna. Group fitness only on Premium tier.
verdict: Best value gym in NZ. At $7.99/week you won't find cheaper with this quality.

google_reviews.name: Tom H.
google_reviews.text: Best value gym in NZ, full stop. $7.99/week and it's 24/7. Equipment is modern and the place is always clean. Can't beat this price.

google_reviews.name: Amy L.
google_reviews.text: Black Card is the move — multi-club access means I can hit whichever location is closest. The tanning and massage chairs are a nice bonus.

google_reviews.name: Daniel W.
google_reviews.text: Some locations are better maintained than others but the price is unbeatable. Upgraded to Premium for group fitness and it's been a game changer.

google_reviews.name: Ngaio F.
google_reviews.text: Gets busy during peak hours but that's expected for the price. Staff are always friendly and helpful when you need them.

google_reviews.name: Callum B.
google_reviews.text: No pool or sauna but everything you need for a solid workout is there. Great for no-frills training on a budget. The 24/7 access is crucial for shift workers.

name: Anytime Fitness
tagline: 24/7 access, 600+ clubs worldwide — great for travellers
cancellation: Must complete minimum term or pay out remaining months
best_for: Frequent travellers, shift workers, those wanting global access
watch_out: 12-month contracts at most locations. No group fitness.
discount_note: Refer a friend for 4 free weeks.
verdict: Best if you travel within NZ or internationally — one membership, 600+ clubs.

google_reviews.name: Chris B.
google_reviews.text: Key fob access is genuinely convenient. I travel for work and being able to use my membership in multiple NZ cities is a huge advantage. Worth the cost for that alone.

google_reviews.name: Sophie M.
google_reviews.text: Clean, well-maintained gym. The 12-month minimum term was a concern but I've been going consistently and it's been well worth it.

google_reviews.name: Liam T.
google_reviews.text: Used my membership in 3 different NZ cities last month. The global access when travelling overseas is incredible — walked into a club in London no problem.

google_reviews.name: Aroha W.
google_reviews.text: The gym itself is solid but pricing varies so much between locations — do your research before signing up as the franchise model causes inconsistency.

google_reviews.name: Ben F.
google_reviews.text: Great community at my local branch. Staff are welcoming and the PT sessions are excellent. Would prefer no lock-in but the service quality makes up for it.

name: Snap Fitness
tagline: 24/7 boutique gym — compact, clean, no frills

pricing.joining_fee_note: Often runs joining fee waiver promos

cancellation: Varies by location — check your contract
best_for: Simple 24/7 gym access, small-town NZ locations
watch_out: Very small clubs — can feel cramped during peak hours.
verdict: Solid 24/7 option especially in smaller NZ towns where other chains don't reach.

google_reviews.name: Ben C.
google_reviews.text: Love the 24/7 access and the small club feel. Never overcrowded, always clean. Perfect for early morning sessions before the office.

google_reviews.name: Emma R.
google_reviews.text: Really well maintained and the staff are friendly. It's not a huge gym but everything you need is there and the equipment is kept in great condition.

google_reviews.name: Jack D.
google_reviews.text: Does what it says — a clean 24/7 gym. No group classes which is the main drawback but for solo training it's perfectly adequate.

google_reviews.name: Tina H.
google_reviews.text: Perfect gym for people who just want to train without the fuss. They were running a joining fee waiver promo when I signed up which saved me $49.

google_reviews.name: Ryan M.
google_reviews.text: Smaller than I expected but surprisingly well-equipped. Great for those who don't like busy gyms — it's rarely packed even at peak times.

name: Jetts
tagline: 24/7 no-contract gym — flexible membership, no joining fee
best_for: Those wanting flexibility, no joining fee, or trying a gym for the first time
watch_out: Fewer locations than Anytime Fitness or Snap. No group classes.
verdict: Best for flexibility — no lock-in, no joining fee, cancel anytime.

google_reviews.name: Matt P.
google_reviews.text: No lock-in and no joining fee was exactly what I needed when I wasn't sure I'd stick with it. Two years later I'm still going regularly — turns out I love it.

google_reviews.name: Claire S.
google_reviews.text: Good value for money. The 24/7 access is essential for me with my irregular work schedule. The lack of group classes is the only downside.

google_reviews.name: Ryan K.
google_reviews.text: Clean gyms, decent equipment, flexible membership. Fewer locations than competitors but my local branch has everything I need for a good workout.

google_reviews.name: Mei L.
google_reviews.text: Solid gym for basic training. Equipment felt a bit limited at my local branch. Staff interaction is minimal which suits some people perfectly.

google_reviews.name: Hamish T.
google_reviews.text: The no joining fee sealed the deal for me. Tried three other gyms before this and the flexibility here is unmatched. No pressure, just a good gym.

name: YMCA
tagline: Community gym with pools — best for families and swimmers
watch_out: Not open 24/7. Limited locations. Hours more restricted.
verdict: Best for families with kids — pool, crèche, and community feel.

google_reviews.name: Helen B.
google_reviews.text: Perfect for our family. The pool is great for the kids on weekends and the crèche means I can actually get a proper workout in during the week.

google_reviews.name: David N.
google_reviews.text: Community gym feel that the big commercial chains simply can't replicate. Staff know my name after a month, which makes a real difference to my motivation.

google_reviews.name: Kate M.
google_reviews.text: Facilities are a bit dated compared to Les Mills but the price, pool, and community feel more than make up for it. Wouldn't go anywhere else.

google_reviews.name: Sam T.
google_reviews.text: Would be better with 24/7 access but I understand it's a community operation. The pool is genuinely excellent and the concession rates are very fair.

google_reviews.name: Aroha P.
google_reviews.text: Swimming lessons for the kids plus my own gym membership in one place. The community vibe here is something special — everyone looks out for each other.

name: F45 Training
best_for: HIIT lovers, people who need group motivation, fast results
watch_out: Most expensive option. No self-directed training — classes only.
discount_note: First week free at most studios.
verdict: Best results for the motivated — but at a premium price.

google_reviews.name: Josh W.
google_reviews.text: F45 completely transformed how I approach fitness. The team environment makes it impossible not to push harder and the 45-minute sessions fit perfectly into a busy schedule.

google_reviews.name: Anna C.
google_reviews.text: Best fitness decision I've made. Trainers know everyone by name and the workout variety means I never get bored. Down 6kg in 2 months.

google_reviews.name: Nathan F.
google_reviews.text: Expensive but genuinely effective. The mix of cardio and strength days keeps things interesting. The 'party round' at the end is absolutely brutal in the best way.

google_reviews.name: Lucy M.
google_reviews.text: Love the workouts but the cost adds up quickly. At around $185/month it's a significant investment — worth it if you commit and attend consistently.

google_reviews.name: Chloe T.
google_reviews.text: Tried the free first week and was hooked immediately. The energy in a room of 20 people all pushing hard together is unlike anything at a regular gym.

name: ClassPass
tagline: Access hundreds of NZ gyms and studios on one membership

tiers.name: Unlimited (80 credits)
tiers.includes: Unlimited classes at any partner studio

best_for: Variety seekers, travelers, trying different fitness styles
watch_out: Credits expire monthly. Popular classes book out fast.
discount_note: First month free. Student discounts available.
verdict: Best for variety — access yoga, pilates, HIIT, cycling and more on one plan.
pros: Hundreds of studios in one membership
cons: Gets expensive if you want unlimited

google_reviews.name: Olivia H.
google_reviews.text: The ultimate flexible membership. I've done yoga, reformer pilates, boxing and cycling all on one plan. The app makes booking incredibly easy.

google_reviews.name: Marcus T.
google_reviews.text: Great for variety but you need to be strategic about credits. Popular classes book out early so plan your week ahead. The free first month is a genuine no-risk trial.

google_reviews.name: Nicole K.
google_reviews.text: On the standard plan — covers 8 classes a month which is perfect for my schedule. Saving money vs a traditional gym while doing more varied workouts.

google_reviews.name: Alex B.
google_reviews.text: Credits expiring is frustrating when life gets busy. The flexibility is unmatched though, and the free trial lets you work out if the credit system suits your lifestyle.

google_reviews.name: Hannah W.
google_reviews.text: Found studios I never knew existed. ClassPass has opened up the fitness scene for me — tried 12 different studios in 3 months and found 3 I absolutely love.

name: Orangetheory Fitness
tagline: Heart rate-based HIIT — science-backed 60-minute coached sessions

tiers.name: Basic (4 classes/mo)
tiers.includes: 4 classes per month with heart rate monitor

tiers.name: Elite (8 classes/mo)
tiers.includes: 8 classes per month + OTbeat Live tracking

tiers.name: Premier (Unlimited)
tiers.includes: Unlimited monthly classes + premium heart rate band

best_for: Data-driven fitness lovers, weight loss goals, people who want guided coaching every session
watch_out: Expensive for unlimited. Class-times only — no open gym access. Few NZ locations.
discount_note: First class free. Refer a friend for free classes.
verdict: Premium boutique HIIT with real-time heart rate coaching. Outstanding results if you commit.
cons: Class times only — no open gym

google_reviews.name: Zara M.
google_reviews.text: Nothing has transformed my fitness like Orangetheory. The OTbeat heart rate monitor keeps you accountable and the splat points system is genuinely addictive. Down 9kg in 4 months.

google_reviews.name: Tom W.
google_reviews.text: Worth every cent. The science-based approach means every session has a real purpose. The instructors are world class and the community is incredibly supportive.

google_reviews.name: Jade L.
google_reviews.text: Premium price but premium experience. Lost 8kg in 3 months. The mix of cardio and strength days keeps things interesting and you never do the same workout twice.

google_reviews.name: Mark S.
google_reviews.text: Great workout concept but the unlimited plan is expensive. Commit to 3+ sessions per week and it's worth it — otherwise the per-class rate gets costly.

google_reviews.name: Sophie R.
google_reviews.text: First class free got me in the door and I've been going 4 times a week ever since. The coaches know your name from day one and the energy in the room is electric.

name: Contours Women's Gym
tagline: Women-only circuit gym — 30-minute sessions, welcoming atmosphere

pricing.joining_fee_note: No joining fee on most plans

best_for: Women who want a supportive, non-intimidating gym, beginners, busy mums
watch_out: Women-only. Not 24/7. Circuit-guided sessions only — no open gym access.
discount_note: Free trial week available at most locations.
verdict: Best women's gym in NZ — affordable, supportive, and effective for all fitness levels.

google_reviews.name: Fiona T.
google_reviews.text: Finally a gym where I feel completely comfortable! The women-only environment makes such a difference. The 30-minute circuit is perfect for busy mums — in, done, and home.

google_reviews.name: Janet K.
google_reviews.text: Been a member for 3 years and wouldn't change it. The staff remember everyone and it genuinely feels like a community. Lost 12kg since joining.

google_reviews.name: Karen W.
google_reviews.text: Love the circuit format — in and out in 30 minutes. Ideal if you're not sure where to start at the gym. The instructors explain every exercise and keep you on track.

google_reviews.name: Brenda L.
google_reviews.text: Affordable, friendly and genuinely effective. I tried the big chains before and never felt comfortable. Contours changed my relationship with exercise entirely.

google_reviews.name: Renee O.
google_reviews.text: If you're nervous about going to a gym for the first time, start here. No judgment, no confusion about what to do — just a supportive group of women encouraging each other.

name: 9Round
tagline: 30-minute kickboxing circuit — no class times, just show up
hours: 6am–7pm weekdays, 8am–12pm weekends — no set class times, start anytime
best_for: Busy people who can't commit to fixed class times, cardio seekers, stress relief
watch_out: Kickboxing-focused — not a full gym. No weights room or machines.
discount_note: Free first session. Bring a friend free.
verdict: Best for no-schedule fitness — 9 kickboxing stations, a trainer guides every session, done in 30 min.
pros: No class times — start anytime in the hour
cons: Pricier than basic gyms for what you get

google_reviews.name: Dave H.
google_reviews.text: No class times means I can train whenever I want. A trainer guides you through the 30-minute circuit every session. Best gym format for a genuinely busy lifestyle.

google_reviews.name: Renee C.
google_reviews.text: Completely addicted to the boxing bag workouts. Great cardio and incredible stress relief. The trainers push you hard but never make it intimidating.

google_reviews.name: Paul M.
google_reviews.text: Great concept — 9 stations, 3 minutes each. I was sceptical about 30 minutes being enough but I'm drenched in sweat every single time. Surprisingly effective.

google_reviews.name: Lisa T.
google_reviews.text: Love that there are no set class times. The kickboxing elements are genuinely fun and the trainers tailor the intensity to your fitness level. Excellent for beginners.

google_reviews.name: Connor B.
google_reviews.text: Tried the free first session and signed up immediately. 30 minutes is all you need — you work harder here in half an hour than 90 minutes at a traditional gym.
